title: Council of Six
wikitext:
The '''Council of Six''',<ref>[[Khadgar's Journal]]</ref><ref name="Modera daughter">[[Magistrate Modera#Quotes]]</ref> also known as the '''Six''',<ref>[[Archmage Angela Dosantos#Quotes]]</ref> is the name given to the [[Kirin Tor]] high council of [[Dalaran (kingdom)|Dalaran]]. These six individuals were the leaders of both the city and all territories under the control of Dalaran. The Six were usually the most senior, but not necessarily the most gifted. They were chosen by several means, magic but one of them.<ref name="DotD1">''[[Day of the Dragon]]'', chapter 1</ref>

Traditionally, the membership of the Council of Six was kept a strict secret. When someone met with the Council officially, it was always in a special, enchanted chamber, the Chamber of the Air, a room with no visible walls — the gray stone floor with its central diamond symbol stood beneath an open sky that shifted and changed rapidly, as if the time sped past within the chamber.<ref name="DotD1" />

==Known members==
===Current===
* [[Modera]] - Member after the Second War<ref>''[[Day of the Dragon]]'', chapter 13</ref> and in the years leading up to the Third War.<ref name="RtD" /> Still a member to this day, working on the reconstruction of Dalaran.<ref name="Modera daughter" />

===Former===
* [[Kael'thas Sunstrider]] - Prince of Quel'Thalas, member in the years leading up to the Third War.<ref name="RtD">''[[Road to Damnation]]''</ref> Departed from the Alliance after the Third War and joined the [[Illidari]].
* [[Kel'Thuzad]] - Expelled for practicing necromancy, then traveled to Northrend and formed the Cult of the Damned to serve the Lich King.<ref name="RtD" />
* [[Krasus]] - Humanoid form of [[Korialstrasz]]. Member after the Second War,<ref>''[[Day of the Dragon]]'', chapter 2</ref> but took his leave from the Council several years before the Third War to be with [[Alexstrasza]].<ref>''[[Day of the Dragon]]'', chapter 21</ref>
* [[Antonidas]] - Head of the Kirin Tor during the [[Third War]].<ref>''Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos'' Game Manual, ''[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Warcraft_III:_Reign_of_Chaos_Game_Manual#Antonidas Heroes and Villains]'', Antonidas</ref> Killed by [[Arthas Menethil]].
* [[Drenden]] - Member after the Second War<ref>''[[Day of the Dragon]]'', chapter 12</ref> and in the years leading up to the Third War.<ref name="RtD" /> Unknown status after the Third War.
